name: multi-company-portal
description: Multi-company login portal that hosts the FinTrack financial app per tenant, with master/staff accounts.
whatsNew: The How-to guide now has a section on the four Details pages — Bank Details, your company's own Details page, Payment Gateway Details and Game Kiosk Details. It explains what each one holds, who can edit it, and how the SHOW and COPY buttons work on a hidden password.

The guide also caught up on the smaller recent changes: the "OTP link" button and PayID on a bank's card, the "who deleted this and when" line under a deleted entry, and the company name now shown in the browser tab.
As always, all of it reads in English, 中文 (Chinese) and ភាសាខ្មែរ (Khmer) — open it from your account menu or the "?" button.
